title: Uffington White Horse Hill as a thunderstorm generator for Avebury

tellings.quote: This is a picture of one of the White Horse Hills, the Upington White Horse Hill that were used to generate cumuloneimus thunderstorm clouds

plain: The Uffington White Horse, a giant ancient chalk figure of a horse cut into an English hillside, is said to have been used to generate cumulonimbus clouds, the towering clouds that bring thunderstorms, apparently for the ancient stone circle at Avebury nearby. A researcher of ancient sites named Geoffrey Drumm puts this forward on Michels' show, showing a picture and naming no source. If true, it would make the figure a piece of ancient weather machinery rather than just art.
